arStrings.szText: Slot up to {c_highlight}3 {icon:Icon_Chaos_Diamond,2.} Chaos Perks{/c} to twist and empower your skills.
Equip one {icon:Icon_Chaos_Circle,2.} Unique Perk to dramatically reshape your entire build.
Each class unlocks different Chaos Perks, offering distinct paths to power.
Earn Chaos Perks by progressing through the Seasonal Reputation Board. Defeat Bartuc to claim Unique Perks.
